coverage_status_definitions.DERIVABLE: Required source records exist in the immutable development bundle, but this field has not yet been materialized under V3.
coverage_status_definitions.PARTIAL: Some required source, history, timestamp, resolution, or lineage exists, but the book requirement is not fully met.
coverage_status_definitions.PRESENT: The immutable development bundle already records the field or a directly reusable point-in-time representation.
coverage_status_definitions.UNAVAILABLE: No valid point-in-time development source is currently present.
coverage_status_definitions.OUT_OF_SCOPE: The book requirement is intentionally excluded by the V3 no-execution boundary.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Separate facts from assumptions and retain source, availability, revision, and audit lineage.
limitations: Nested facts still require individual available_at enforcement during V3 materialization.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Every decision fact must satisfy available_at <= decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Identify the actual instrument and distinguish broker XAUUSD from OTC spot and COMEX futures.
limitations: IC Markets XAUUSD is a broker CFD/feed, not the complete global gold market.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Instrument metadata is versioned and known before the session.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record tradable XAUUSD price and bar completeness at the decision clock.
limitations: Broker price may differ slightly from other venues.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use only complete bars available no later than decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record bid-ask spread as a direct liquidity and execution-quality observation.
limitations: Broker spread is a local liquidity observation, not full-market depth.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Measure from the latest complete eligible bar or a preregistered trailing window.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record trading activity while distinguishing broker tick volume from centralized futures volume.
limitations: Broker tick volume is present; centralized intraday COMEX gold volume is absent from the immutable bundle.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Never relabel tick volume as COMEX contract volume.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Measure market depth, resilience, slippage, and price impact as distinct liquidity dimensions.
limitations: No historical order-book depth or trade-level impact source is present.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Remain UNKNOWN; spread or candle range may not be presented as observed depth.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Do not infer participant identity or motive directly from order direction or price movement.
limitations: Most OTC and dealer-client flow is not publicly observable.
source_lineage: ETF or central-bank sources if later licensed
field_requirements.timing_rule: Any interpretation must list evidence and explicitly say motive is not directly observed.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Detect swing highs/lows and HH, HL, LH, and LL sequences deterministically.
limitations: Results depend on frozen lookback and pivot rules; detected_at may be later than pivot timestamp.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use detection time, not retrospective pivot time, for availability.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Classify trend and range without vague discretionary pattern names.
limitations: Finite deterministic lookbacks are feature definitions, not universal market truth.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Snapshot as_of and available_at must be no later than decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record support, resistance, prior highs/lows, and the method that produced each level.
limitations: A level is an area of prior interaction, not a guaranteed reversal point.
source_lineage: prior session and prior period bars
field_requirements.timing_rule: Only levels fully formed and detected before decision_at are eligible.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Detect break of structure and market-structure shift with evidence and invalidation.
limitations: BOS and MSS are deterministic labels, not trade triggers.
field_requirements.timing_rule: detected_at controls eligibility.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Measure compression, expansion, displacement, and momentum.
limitations: Thresholds must be frozen before relationship testing.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Trailing windows end no later than decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Distinguish breakout, acceptance, rejection, failed breakout, trapped breakout, and retest.
limitations: Post-decision interactions are outcomes and must never enter decision_state.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Pre-decision detections and post-decision interactions are stored in separate branches.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record likely liquidity and stop zones while labelling them as interpretations rather than observed orders.
limitations: No aggregate stop ledger is observed.
source_lineage: known swing, range, session, and round-number levels
field_requirements.timing_rule: Evidence must predate the decision; never claim stops are directly observed.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Use current level, direction, and rate of change when classifying the macro environment.
limitations: Mixed-frequency releases and market series require explicit staleness.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Select the latest vintage available at decision_at and preserve prior vintages.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track headline and core CPI levels and changes.
limitations: Release vintage and later revisions must remain distinct.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use only vintages available at decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track headline and core PCE levels and changes.
limitations: Mixed release frequencies require explicit age and next-release context.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use only vintages available at decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track payrolls, unemployment, wage growth, and jobless claims.
limitations: Payroll revisions can materially change the historical story and must remain vintage-aware.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Release and revision availability control use.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track GDP and retail-sales levels and momentum.
limitations: GDP is low frequency and revision-prone.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use the vintage first known by decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track the Fed policy rate and its change.
limitations: Effective rate is not identical to the target range or future path.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use only observations available at decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track 2-year nominal Treasury yield as a policy-expectation channel.
limitations: FRED yield is daily; ZT futures provide separate intraday price context, not an observed yield.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Daily yields obey publication availability; futures changes crossing rolls are UNKNOWN.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track 10-year nominal Treasury yield.
limitations: FRED yield is daily; ZN futures are an intraday price proxy, not the yield itself.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Futures roll crossings are UNKNOWN.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track 10-year real yield as a central gold transmission channel.
limitations: Development source is daily rather than session-tick resolution.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use only the latest publication available at decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track 10-year breakeven inflation.
limitations: Development source is daily and may not resolve intraday event repricing.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use only the latest publication available at decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track the yield-curve slope and its direction.
limitations: Inputs must share a valid point-in-time publication boundary.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Calculate only from simultaneously eligible vintages.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track the dollar and distinguish conventional inverse confirmation from joint gold-dollar moves.
limitations: Daily broad-dollar index and intraday EURUSD proxy are not identical to DXY.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Provider and proxy identity must remain explicit.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track equity risk sentiment and volatility.
limitations: Intraday US500 source ends 2022-01-14; later intraday values are stale, while daily public series remain separate.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Stale intraday US500 is UNKNOWN, never neutral.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track financial and credit stress when safe-haven or liquidity behaviour dominates.
limitations: Low-frequency public stress indices may lag acute intraday stress.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use only published values available by decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Classify Goldilocks, soft landing, overheating, slowdown, recession/disinflation, stagflation, deflationary stress, and financial/liquidity stress.
limitations: A regime is a transparent interpretation of inputs, not an observed market fact.
field_requirements.timing_rule: All component evidence must be point-in-time eligible.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Identify the current market reaction function so weights can vary by what markets are pricing.
limitations: Must remain transparent and frozen before candidate testing; it is not an outcome-derived label.
source_lineage: recent point-in-time event and cross-market evidence
field_requirements.timing_rule: May use only reactions complete before decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Compare actual releases with the point-in-time consensus available before release.
limitations: Historical MetaQuotes forecasts lack verified pre-event first-publication timestamps and cannot support a pre-release edge.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Forecast is pre-event eligible only when forecast_as_of and available_at are verified before scheduled_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Compare actual with previous and preserve later revisions separately.
limitations: Original and revised values must never be collapsed into a single hindsight series.
field_requirements.timing_rule: A revision enters only at its own available_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Calculate raw and standardized economic surprise from actual versus valid point-in-time forecast.
limitations: Post-release surprise is calculable, but historical pre-event forecast eligibility is not generally verified.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Surprise is available no earlier than the actual release and source availability.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track Fed-cut and hike probabilities by meeting.
limitations: Quarterly Atlanta Fed SOFR windows are present but are not exact meeting-level FedWatch distributions.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Do not relabel quarterly windows as meeting probabilities.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track first expected policy move, total easing/tightening, and expected destination rate.
limitations: Quarterly SOFR probability windows provide partial path context, not a complete FOMC meeting curve.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Any transformation must preserve provider, contract, roll, and availability lineage.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Measure hawkish or dovish repricing across the complete expected rate path.
limitations: Intraday ZQ/SR3 changes are proxies and can be UNKNOWN across rolls; complete meeting path is absent.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Compare only point-in-time eligible path snapshots with compatible definitions.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track managed-money longs, shorts, net position, weekly changes, and historical percentile.
limitations: Weekly data describe Tuesday positions published Friday; they are stale relative to intraday trading.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use only reports whose publication_at <= decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track producer/merchant, swap-dealer, and other-reportable positioning and changes.
limitations: Category labels do not prove a specific trade motive.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use publication availability, not Tuesday observation date.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track open interest and weekly change.
limitations: Weekly CFTC open interest exists; intraday COMEX open interest is unavailable.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Never carry weekly open interest as an observed intraday change.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Interpret price up/down with open interest up/down as probable participation, covering, liquidation, or reduction.
limitations: These combinations are probabilistic interpretations, not guaranteed institutional facts.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Inputs must share the same already-published report boundary.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Detect crowding, liquidation risk, covering risk, position building, and position reduction.
limitations: Percentile and change thresholds must be frozen before relationship testing.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Historical percentile uses only reports published by decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track gold ETF holdings and flows and detect ETF divergence.
limitations: No versioned historical ETF source is present in the immutable development bundle.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Remain UNKNOWN unless an approved source with historical availability is added before outcome inspection.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track central-bank gold demand when available.
limitations: No point-in-time historical central-bank purchase dataset is present.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Delayed official reports require their true publication availability.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track options strikes, expiries, calls, puts, implied volatility, and dealer-gamma estimates where data permit.
limitations: No licensed historical COMEX options chain, volatility surface, or dealer-position source is present.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Dealer gamma, if later estimated, is INFERRED and must state model assumptions.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Compare fast-money and slow-money behaviour without conflating the two.
limitations: COT categories exist, but ETF and central-bank slow-money series are absent.
source_lineage: future ETF and central-bank sources if approved
field_requirements.timing_rule: Never infer absent slow-money data as no divergence.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record scheduled event type, clock, importance, and whether schedule was known before the decision.
limitations: Historical MetaQuotes schedules are not verified as published before the event boundary.
field_requirements.timing_rule: An event is upcoming only if its schedule has verified available_at <= decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record forecast, previous, actual, revision, surprise, and release vintage for each event component.
limitations: Post-release components exist; pre-release forecast use is generally unverified.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Each component uses its own released_at and available_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Measure event proximity and reduce confidence before high-impact releases.
limitations: Cannot calculate trustworthy pre-event proximity where schedule availability is unverified.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Only schedules genuinely known by decision_at are eligible.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record reactions after 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, and daily close.
limitations: A reaction may enter a later session decision only after its horizon is complete and available.
field_requirements.timing_rule: No fixed-horizon reaction enters before that horizon has closed.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Measure event MFE, MAE, and whether the first move held or reversed.
limitations: The original immutable event artifact contains fixed horizons but no event MFE/MAE; any later neutral event path requires a separately frozen definition.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Only completed event paths available before session decision may be used.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Include Fed decisions, press conferences, projections, speeches, and Treasury auctions.
limitations: Coverage depends on verified event taxonomy and historical schedule availability; it is not complete in the immutable casebook.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Missing event classes remain UNKNOWN.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record unscheduled geopolitical and financial events.
limitations: No licensed point-in-time historical unscheduled-news archive is present.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Absence of a feed is UNKNOWN, not proof no event occurred.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Interpret event impact from importance, surprise, positioning, liquidity, and current reaction function.
limitations: Historical pre-event forecast and schedule gaps prevent complete coverage.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Only inputs available at decision_at may contribute.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Identify Asia, London, New York, overlap, handover, rollover, and close windows with DST correctness.
limitations: Holiday and venue schedules still require completeness checks.
source_lineage: IANA Asia/Tokyo, Europe/London, and America/New_York timezones
field_requirements.timing_rule: Construct local clocks with the IANA timezone database.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record Asian high, low, range, breakout, and close state before London.
limitations: Uses the frozen casebook Asia definition of 10:05-16:00 Asia/Tokyo.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Asia window must be complete and closed before the London decision.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record London state and range known before the New York decision.
limitations: For London cases, post-decision London state belongs only in subsequent_behaviour.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Only the London path complete by the New York decision may enter a New York decision state.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record New York state and interaction with prior Asia/London levels.
limitations: New York behaviour is an outcome for New York cases.
source_lineage: complete five-minute XAUUSD New York path
field_requirements.timing_rule: decision_eligible is always false.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record London-New York overlap, session handovers, and position-squaring windows.
limitations: Only the portion completed before decision_at may enter decision_state.
field_requirements.timing_rule: No future overlap observation may leak into the decision state.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Identify London AM and PM benchmark windows.
limitations: Exact benchmark rules and holiday exceptions require a frozen calendar definition before materialization.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Only elapsed benchmark windows may contribute to decision_state.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Identify daily rollover, close, spread widening, and abnormal liquidity conditions.
limitations: Spread and volatility proxies exist; depth and resilience do not.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Abnormality uses only a trailing point-in-time baseline.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Detect session confirmation, reversal, acceptance, rejection, and failed breakout.
limitations: These are descriptive post-decision labels, not entries or trade outcomes.
field_requirements.timing_rule: decision_eligible is always false.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Synchronize gold with 2Y, 10Y, real yield, breakeven, dollar, equities, volatility, silver, and Fed expectations.
limitations: Daily yield series and intraday futures proxies have different resolution; US500 is stale after 2022-01-14; exact meeting probabilities are absent.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Every component carries its own timestamp, availability, staleness, and roll quality.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Use silver as a useful precious-metals confirmation where appropriate.
limitations: Broker XAGUSD is a proxy and its own drivers can diverge from gold.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Use only complete eligible bars.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Detect conventional confirmation, divergence, safe-haven behaviour, dollar-and-gold co-movement, and defensive gold demand.
limitations: State definitions and horizons must be frozen before candidate discovery.
field_requirements.timing_rule: No relationship state may use observations after decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Distinguish inflation-driven nominal-yield increases from real-yield-driven pressure.
limitations: Daily real-yield and breakeven data limit intraday attribution.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Attribution must cite contemporaneously available component changes.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record supporting evidence, contradictions, missing drivers, and causal-chain hypotheses transparently.
limitations: Existing engine outputs are research inputs only and cannot be treated as validated directional truth.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Every referenced fact must be eligible at decision_at.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record neutral fixed-horizon movement without assigning a trade side.
limitations: This is a descriptive path coordinate, not return on an assumed fill.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Outcome-only; decision_eligible=false.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record the session's upward and downward reach from a neutral reference.
limitations: Maximum upward/downward displacement is deliberately not side-conditioned MFE/MAE.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Outcome-only; no execution assumption.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record session high, low, their timestamps, and which extreme occurred first.
limitations: Ties and missing bars require an explicit deterministic policy.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Outcome-only; timestamp ordering uses source-bar clocks.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Preserve the full session path and phase changes rather than only open-to-close movement.
limitations: The immutable casebook stores a complete five-minute path plus one-minute source references; V3 must not silently interpolate missing bars.
field_requirements.timing_rule: decision_eligible=false.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record post-decision interaction with levels known at the decision.
limitations: Only levels already known at decision_at may be tested as explanatory context later.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Level definition is pre-decision; interaction is post-decision.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Record close location, path efficiency, reversal, and acceptance/rejection classification.
limitations: Classification thresholds must be fixed in the Milestone 2 measurement manifest, not chosen from conditional performance.
field_requirements.timing_rule: decision_eligible=false.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Separate macro bias, trigger, invalidation, and risk.
limitations: V3 discovers conditional bias and behaviour only; it does not create trade triggers.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Requires a separate future execution-research contract.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Model entry, stop distance, target, reward-to-risk, spread, slippage, latency, and position sizing.
limitations: Explicitly prohibited by V3; prior frozen execution remains historical evidence only.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Requires a separately authorized contract after a bias candidate survives forward evidence.

field_requirements.book_requirement: Track portfolio-cluster exposure, event-risk warnings, slippage warnings, and daily-loss status.
limitations: No trade portfolio exists in V3.
field_requirements.timing_rule: Belongs to a later portfolio/execution system.

forward_coverage_reference.note: Per-partition source presence and timestamp completeness are audited separately without value access.
